verdict.rationale: OneDrive is comprehensively drivable via Microsoft Graph API, with documented endpoints for CRUD operations, upload sessions, search, sharing links, delta/change tracking, versioning, and thumbnails — a well-documented, public, RESTful API surface suitable for programmatic/agentic access. Missing for 10: no evidence of an official OpenAPI/Swagger spec being discoverable (probe returned 404s) and no explicit AI-agent-oriented SDK or MCP-style wrapper, which would round out the 'AI-native' framing.
